conservation.technical_description:
Support: darkening of paper overall; localized lightening of support at figure's proper right shoulder; small minor vertical tears along bottom edge of paper; small scratch along recto right side; small pin scratch at top figure's head; minor staining along top edge. Needs to be rematted to standard size; rehinged and framed. 
 
Frame: multiple areas of scratches and paint loss; acidic backing board on frame; currently hinged to archival window mat. Current frame is not suitable for exhibition; no viable means to secure work during exhibition.

credit_line: Collection of the New Mexico Museum of Art. Bequest of Claudia O'Keeffe, 1988 (1988.130.2).
description: Jane Wyckoff was one of the artist's aunts. A woman, rendered in layers of hatching and crosshatching, looks downward at the center of an oval-shaped composition. The woman wears glasses, a white collar, and a dark bodice and sleeves. Her white, curly hair is pinned up behind her head. At the bottom right of the image is text that reads "G. O'Keeffe." The black and gray portrait is set against exposed white paper, which constitutes the background of the work.
title: Untitled (Jane Wyckoff)
